primaryOutcomeMeasures.description: BMI was calculated using participant's weight and height assessments, using the following formula: BMI = kg/m\^2. Baseline was defined as the most recent measurement prior to the first administration of study drug.

groups.description: Participants received setmelanotide QD via SC injection for 16 weeks. All participants initiated treatment with setmelanotide (starting dose being age dependent) and dose escalated up to a maximum dose of 3.0 mg QD.
groups.title: Setmelanotide

primaryOutcomeMeasures.populationDescription: Participants in the Full Analysis Set were analyzed.
primaryOutcomeMeasures.title: Percentage of Participants With ≥ 5% Reduction in BMI From Baseline After 16 Weeks of Setmelanotide Treatment
